title: Nonclassical Many-Body Superradiant States with Interparticle and Spin-Momentum Entanglement
summary: We present a cross-cavity system in which steady-state superradiance is achieved using solely collective dissipative dynamics. Two cavities symmetrically couple an ensemble of four-level atoms by driving transitions between two electronic states and two motional states along perpendicular cavity axes. Both cavities operate in the bad-cavity regime: one cavity mediates collective atomic decay, while the other cavity, together with a coherent drive, mediates collective pumping via an off-resonant Raman transition.
